entries.question: I want to book an appointment for my parents
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, please note that online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose the department, date, and time slot → Enter your parents' details → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download/Print the appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same steps as the web portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**. You will receive a booking confirmation.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   You can visit the registration counters at the hospital. 
*   **Requirements:** You must bring your parents' **Aadhaar cards** and an active mobile number to receive the OTP for registration.
*   **Fee:** ₹50 (payable at the counter).

**Important Information:**
*   **Timings:** The OPD ticket counter is open Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). It is closed on Sundays and gazetted holidays.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times.
*   **Referrals:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you bring a valid medical referral for the specific department.

For further assistance, you can call the KGMU help desk at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

*Note: I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD. For your safety, please avoid sharing personal details like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers in this chat.*

entries.question: Old patient
entries.answer:
For patients who have previously visited KGMU (old patients), the process for follow-up appointments remains largely the same as for new patients.

**To book a follow-up appointment:**

*   **Online/App:** You can still use the [ORS portal](https://ors.gov.in) or the mobile app. When booking, ensure you use the same mobile number or UHID (Unique Hospital Identification) number associated with their previous visit to link their medical records.
*   **Walk-in:** If visiting the hospital, proceed to the registration counter with their **UHID number** (printed on their old OPD slip) or the mobile number used during their previous registration. This helps the staff quickly retrieve their existing patient file.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Registration Fee:** A flat fee of ₹50 applies for the OPD slip, regardless of whether it is a new or follow-up visit.
*   **Documentation:** Always carry their old OPD slips and any previous investigation reports or prescriptions. This is crucial for the doctors to track their treatment progress.
*   **Timings:** OPD counters close at 1:00 PM (12:00 PM on Saturdays). Please arrive early to ensure you are registered in time.

If you have specific questions about a department or need to check department-wise room numbers, please let me know.

entries.question: मरीज का ऑनलाइन पर्चा कैसे बनाये
entries.answer:
के.जी.एम.यू. (KGMU) में मरीज का ऑनलाइन पर्चा (OPD Appointment) बनाने के लिए आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों का उपयोग कर सकते हैं:

**1. ऑनलाइन पोर्टल (ORS) के माध्यम से:**
*   वेबसाइट [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं।
*   लॉगिन/रजिस्टर करें।
*   राज्य (Uttar Pradesh) और अस्पताल (KGMU) का चयन करें।
*   'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करें।
*   विभाग (Department), तारीख और समय का स्लॉट चुनें।
*   मरीज का विवरण भरें और ₹50 का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें।
*   अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप डाउनलोड करें।

**2. मोबाइल ऐप के माध्यम से:**
*   KGMU Play Store से 'ABHA' या 'Health Care' ऐप डाउनलोड करें।
*   अपने मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्टर करें।
*   ORS पोर्टल की तरह ही अस्पताल और विभाग का चयन कर अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करें।

**3. SMS के माध्यम से:**
*   अपने मोबाइल से **"Appointment [मरीज का नाम]"** लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेजें। आपको बुकिंग की पुष्टि प्राप्त होगी।

**4. अस्पताल में सीधे (Walk-in):**
*   आप अस्पताल के पंजीकरण काउंटर पर भी जा सकते हैं।
*   **आवश्यक दस्तावेज:** मरीज का आधार कार्ड और चालू मोबाइल नंबर।
*   काउंटर पर विवरण देने के बाद आपको एक OTP प्राप्त होगा, जिसे बताने के बाद आप ₹50 का भुगतान करके फिजिकल OPD पर्चा प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
*   ऑनलाइन बुकिंग की सलाह दी जाती है ताकि लंबी लाइनों से बचा जा सके।
*   OPD का समय सोमवार–शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार को सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक है। रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।

यदि आपको स्वास्थ्य संबंधी कोई समस्या है, तो कृपया किसी योग्य डॉक्टर से सलाह लें या KGMU OPD में संपर्क करें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए इस चैट में कोई भी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य विवरण या आधार नंबर साझा न करें।

entries.question: BSC bio ke bad
entries.answer:
BSc (Biology) ke baad aapke paas KGMU aur medical field mein kai career vikalp (options) hote hain. Aap apni ruchi ke anusar inmein se chun sakte hain:

### 1. KGMU mein Post-Graduate Courses (Masters)
Agar aap padhai jaari rakhna chahte hain, toh KGMU mein kai PG courses hote hain jo BSc graduates ke liye hain:
*   **MSc in Medical Anatomy, Physiology, ya Biochemistry:** In subjects mein MSc karke aap medical colleges mein tutor ya faculty ban sakte hain.
*   **MSc in Medical Microbiology:** Clinical labs aur diagnostics mein career ke liye behtar hai.
*   **MSc in Biotechnology/Biochemistry:** Research mein jaane ke liye.

### 2. Paramedical aur Technical Courses
Agar aap medical field mein technical role chahte hain, toh BSc ke baad aap ye kar sakte hain:
*   **MLT (Medical Lab Technology):** Lab technician banne ke liye.
*   **Radiology/Imaging Technology:** CT/MRI technician ke liye.
*   **Perfusion Technology:** Cardiac surgery mein sahayata ke liye.

### 3. Research mein Career
KGMU mein kai research projects chalte hain (jaise **DHR-MRU** - [https://kgmudhrmru.in/](https://kgmudhrmru.in/)).
*   Aap **Lab Technician, Research Assistant, ya Data Entry Operator** ke roop mein project-based jobs ke liye apply kar sakte hain. Jab bhi project mein vacancy aati hai, wo KGMU ki website par "Notice Board" mein dikh jati hai.

### 4. Competitive Exams
BSc Biology ke baad aap ye sarkari parikshayein de sakte hain:
*   **Combined Medical Services (UPSC) ka syllabus dekh sakte hain (agar MBBS ho), par BSc ke liye:**
*   **UPSSSC:** Lab technician aur anya paramedical post ke liye.
*   **Nursing Officer (AIIMS/NORCET):** Agar aapne BSc Nursing kiya hai, toh ye sabse achha option hai.
*   **State Health Mission (UPNHM):** Staff nurse ya technician ki bharti ke liye.

### Aapko kya karna chahiye?
1.  **Website check karein:** Niyamit roop se [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par "Courses/Admission" aur "Notice Board" section dekhte rahein.
2.  **Skill Development:** Agar aap lab mein kaam karna chahte hain, toh kisi achhi jagah se 'Hands-on training' ya 'Certificate course' karein.
3.  **Entrance Exam:** KGMU mein PG courses mein admission lene ke liye entrance exam dena hota hai, iski taiyari shuru karein.

**Kya aap kisi specific field (jaise Lab, Research, ya Teaching) mein jana chahte hain?** Agar aap batayenge, toh main aapko aur behtar jankari de paunga.

entries.answer:
BSc (Biology) ke baad KGMU mein naukri paane ke liye aapko ye samajhna hoga ki KGMU mein sidhi (direct) bharti BSc degree ke basis par kam hoti hai, lekin kai raaste hain jinke zariye aap wahan kaam kar sakte hain:

### 1. Project-Based Research Jobs (Sabse jyada mauke)
KGMU mein kai sarkari aur private research projects (jaise ICMR, DBT, ya DHR-MRU) chalte hain. In projects mein **Research Assistant, Lab Technician, ya Field Worker** ki zarurat hoti hai.
*   **Kaise check karein:** [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) ko har hafte check karein. Yahan "Walk-in-interview" ya "Application invited for project" ke notifications aate hain.
*   **DHR-MRU:** [https://kgmudhrmru.in/](https://kgmudhrmru.in/) website ko bhi dekhte rahein, yahan research se judi vacancies aati rehti hain.

### 2. Lab Technician ya Technical Posts (Paramedical)
Agar aapne BSc ke baad koi Diploma in Medical Lab Technology (DMLT) ya koi technical certificate kiya hai, toh aap Technician ki posts ke liye eligible ho sakte hain.
*   **UPSSSC:** Uttar Pradesh mein lab technician ki bharti aksar UPSSSC ke madhyam se hoti hai, jismein KGMU ke liye bhi seats aati hain.

### 3. Administrative ya Data Entry Jobs
KGMU ke vibhagon (Departments) mein data entry aur office work ke liye bhi vacancy aati hai. 
*   Iske liye computer knowledge (MS Office, Typing) hona zaroori hai. 
*   Naukri ke liye aapko KGMU ki official website par 'Recruitment' section par nazar rakhni hogi.

### 4. Admission lekar Career banana (MSc/PhD)
Agar aap BSc ke baad KGMU mein hi MSc (Medical) ya PhD karte hain, toh aapko wahan ke lab system aur faculty ke saath kaam karne ka mauka milta hai, jo baad mein naukri paane mein madad karta hai.

### Aapko kya steps lene chahiye?
1.  **Website par nazar rakhein:** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar "Notice Board" aur "Recruitment" section ko bookmark kar lein.
2.  **Documents taiyar rakhein:** Apni degree, marksheet, aur agar koi computer ya lab training certificate hai, toh uska ek folder bana lein.
3.  **Newspaper:** Lucknow ke local newspapers (Amar Ujala, Dainik Jagran) mein KGMU ki vacancy ke vigyapan (ads) aksar chhate hain, unhein dekhte rahein.
4.  **Networking:** KGMU mein agar koi jaan-pehchan ke log (staff ya students) hain, toh unse puchte rahein ki kisi project mein recruitment chal rahi hai kya.

**Ek zaroori baat:** KGMU mein naukri ke naam par kisi ko paise na dein. Jo bhi bharti hoti hai, wo official website par notification aane ke baad hi hoti hai.

Kya aapne BSc ke baad koi aur diploma (jaise MLT, DMLT) kiya hai? Agar haan, toh main aapko usse judi specific jagah bata sakta hoon.

3. **Official Updates:** CNET se judi sabhi jaankari, exam date, aur application form ke liye aap **Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University (ABVMU)** ki official website [www.abvmuup.edu.in](https://www.abvmuup.edu.in) par check karte rahein, kyunki yahi university CNET conduct karati hai.

entries.question: Kitne number lane padte hai approx
entries.answer:
CNET (Common Nursing Entrance Test) mein kitne marks chahiye, yeh har saal paper ke kathinai star (difficulty level) aur competition par nirbhar karta hai.

KGMU mein admission paane ke liye aapko **top rank** laani hoti hai, kyunki yeh sabse zyada demand wala college hai.

**Ek anuman (Approximate) ke taur par:**

1. **Target Score:** KGMU mein seat secure karne ke liye, aapko **200 mein se kam se kam 130 se 145+ marks** ka target rakhna chahiye. 
2. **Category (OBC):** OBC category ke liye cutoff, General se thoda kam hota hai, lekin KGMU ke liye competition bahut zyada hota hai, isliye aapko koshish karni chahiye ki aapki rank top 200-300 ke andar ho.
3. **Competition:** Kyunki CNET pura Uttar Pradesh level ka exam hai, isliye lakhon bachhe ise dete hain. KGMU ki seats limited hain, isliye jitne zyada marks honge, admission ki sambhavna utni hi mazboot hogi.

**Taiyari ke liye tips:**
* **Syllabus:** Physics, Chemistry, Biology (11th & 12th NCERT), English, Nursing Aptitude aur General Knowledge par dhyan dein.
* **Previous Year Papers:** ABVMU ki website par pichle saal ke papers honge, unhe zaroor solve karein. Isse aapko paper ka pattern samajh aa jayega.
* **Mock Tests:** Jitne zyada ho sake mock tests dein taaki aapki speed aur accuracy badhe.

**Yaad rakhein:** Admission sirf marks par nahi, balki counselling mein aapki **Rank** par depend karta hai. Isliye sirf "pass" hone ka nahi, balki "top rank" lane ka lakshya rakhein.

entries.question: Har saal kitne form bhar jate hai approx cnet me

Ek anuman (approximate) ke taur par, pichle kuch saalon ke aakdon ko dekhein toh:

1. **Sankhya:** Har saal lagbhag **1.5 lakh se 2 lakh** ke beech chhatra is exam ke liye form bharte hain. 
2. **Competition:** Kyunki yeh exam pure Uttar Pradesh ke sabhi government aur private nursing colleges mein admission ke liye ek "Common" exam hai, isliye ismein bhag lene wale chhatron ki sankhya kaafi zyada hoti hai.
3. **KGMU ka Competition:** In 1.5 - 2 lakh chhatron mein se jo top rankers hote hain, unki pehli pasand hamesha KGMU hoti hai. Iska matlab yeh hai ki KGMU ki seats ke liye aapka mukabla un chhatron se hai jo exam mein top 1% ya 2% rank laate hain.

**Yaad rakhein:** Form bharne walon ki sankhya chahe kitni bhi ho, aapka focus sirf apne **"Target Score"** aur **"Rank"** par hona chahiye. Competition zyada hai, isliye apni mehnat mein koi kami na rakhein.

entries.question: Nephrology kya hai
entries.answer:
Nephrology (नेफ्रोलॉजी) चिकित्सा विज्ञान की वह शाखा है जो **गुर्दों (kidneys) से संबंधित बीमारियों** के निदान और उपचार से जुड़ी है।

*   **क्रोनिक किडनी रोग (CKD):** किडनी का धीरे-धीरे काम करना बंद कर देना।

*   **किडनी स्टोन (पथरी):** जो बार-बार बनते हैं या जटिल होते हैं।
*   **ब्लड प्रेशर से जुड़ी समस्याएं:** जो किडनी के कारण होती हैं।
*   **किडनी ट्रांसप्लांट:** गुर्दा प्रत्यारोपण के पहले और बाद की देखभाल।
*   **डायलिसिस:** उन मरीजों के लिए जिन्हें कृत्रिम रूप से खून साफ करने की आवश्यकता होती है।

entries.question: Kya new education sistam  ane ke bad dental hygienist cours ko bilkul band kar diya gaya hai india me
entries.answer:
Nayi Shiksha Niti (NEP) ya kisi aur educational system ke aane ke baad Dental Hygienist ka course Bharat mein **bilkul band nahi kiya gaya hai**. 

Iske baare mein kuch mahatvapurn baatein ye hain:

1. **Course ka status:** Dental Hygienist ka course abhi bhi Bharat mein chalu hai, lekin ise chalane ki zimmedari aur niyam **Dental Council of India (DCI)** ke under aate hain. 
2. **KGMU mein sthiti:** KGMU ek premier medical university hai jo mukhya roop se high-level medical education (MBBS, BDS, MDS, DM, MCh) par focus karti hai. Ho sakta hai ki KGMU ne administrative ya policy changes ke karan is vocational course ko apne campus se hatakar dusre institutions ya state-level paramedical colleges ko transfer kar diya ho.
3. **Kahan hota hai ye course:** Bharat mein aaj bhi kai government aur private dental colleges hain jo DCI se manyata prapt Dental Hygienist aur Dental Mechanic ke courses karate hain. 
4. **NEP ka prabhav:** NEP ke aane se courses ko aur adhik "skill-based" banaya ja raha hai. Kai jagah inhe ab "Certificate" ya "Diploma" courses ke roop mein vocational training ke sath joda ja raha hai.

**Sahi jankari kaise prapt karein:**
Agar aap Dental Hygienist course mein admission lena chahte hain, toh aap **Dental Council of India (DCI)** ki official website [dciindia.gov.in](https://dciindia.gov.in/) par jaakar "Recognized Dental Hygienist Courses" ki list dekh sakte hain. Wahan aapko un sabhi colleges ki jaankari mil jayegi jahan ye course abhi bhi active hai.

Main ek AI assistant hoon aur meri jaankari KGMU ke website data tak seemit hai. Aap DCI ki website ko check karein, wahan aapko sabse sahi aur updated list milegi.

*   **जरूरी दस्तावेज:** अपने साथ आधार कार्ड और यदि आप लखनऊ के बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग का रेफरल लेटर (Referral Letter) जरूर लाएं।

**3. कुछ महत्वपूर्ण बातें:**
*   समय पर पहुँचें क्योंकि काउंटर जल्दी बंद हो जाते हैं और भीड़ अधिक होती है।
*   मैं एक AI सहायक हूँ, यदि आपको कोई गंभीर चोट या इमरजेंसी है, तो कृपया सीधे **ट्रॉमा सेंटर (गेट नंबर 14)** पर जाएं।
*   मैं आपकी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य स्थिति के आधार पर उपचार नहीं बता सकता। कृपया डॉक्टर से व्यक्तिगत रूप से परामर्श लें।

अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप विभाग की वेबसाइट देख सकते हैं: [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=22&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=22&dept_type=2)
